summary: v52cz rev9 frontend-only testing: escrow registration wizard (steps 2+3) and admin console (notice↔escrow routing + duplicates banner). 3/4 flows verified green, 1 is N/A (no duplicates in preview DB).

integration_issues.issue: Clicking the '+ Add "<name>"' button fires the success toast TWICE (two identical toasts stacked). mastersApi.suggestBank network call likely dispatched twice (either React StrictMode double-invoke of onMouseDown handler or useEffect re-trigger after onPatch). Functionally correct — bank is upserted idempotently by server and field keeps new value — but UX shows duplicate toast.

Clicked notice-account-bulk-apply with 1 ticked notice + Kaspi account picked. No success toast captured in 5s window (toasts panel was empty). No 422/error visible either. Needs manual re-verification — likely transient but worth E1 confirming the 'Bulk assigned N notice' toast actually fires.

design_issues.screen: Escrow wizard step 2 Signatories on mobile (390px)
issues: The phone-local digits input slightly overflows the signatory row rect by ~24px on 390px viewport (phone-local right=365 vs row right=341). Visually it stays within the outer card padding so may not be perceptible, but worth E1 reviewing — set the phone wrap min-width:0 or flex-1.

action_items: Investigate double-fired success toast on BankNameAutocomplete '+ Add' button (suggestBank called twice).
Manually re-confirm 'Bulk assigned N notice' toast fires on notice-account-bulk-apply (per-row flow works and shows the correct toast).
critical_code_review_comments: EscrowBankingStep.jsx BankNameAutocomplete uses onMouseDown handler which can double-fire with React StrictMode in dev; consider onClick + e.preventDefault() to avoid double-dispatch.

EscrowInstitutionRegister.jsx step 2 row uses md:grid-cols-2 which fixes desktop overflow (verified) but mobile could use min-w-0 on PhonePrefixInput wrapper to prevent minor overflow in <400px viewports.

success_rate.frontend: 3/4 green, 1 N/A (dupes banner), 2 minor UX nits
